gaps.sentence: Do come round ___ dinner next week.
gaps.explanation: come round = visit; come round FOR dinner/TO our place.

gaps.sentence: If you don't know the word, look it ___ in a dictionary.
gaps.explanation: look a word up = find it in a dictionary/reference.

gaps.sentence: She's been going ___ a difficult time at work.
Many consumers now opt ___ cheaper brands.
The band broke ___ in the middle of the song.
The match was called ___ because of the storm.
I ran ___ my old teacher at the airport.
gaps.explanation: run into somebody = meet them by chance (also: bump into).

gaps.sentence: They put ___ the meeting until everyone could attend.
